verdict.rationale: Baseten's first-party docs describe fine-tuning a supported base model with Loops or Training Jobs, syncing checkpoints during training, and deploying any synced checkpoint as a production endpoint on the same platform with one CLI command. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-tune-to-serve workflow, and detail on how user data is supplied to Loops.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform

citations.quote: Baseten trains models on managed GPUs and deploys the resulting checkpoints to production inference on the same platform.
Fine-tuning or running RL on a supported base model: Loops provisions a dedicated trainer and paired sampler, and each training step is an API call from a Python loop you write.
Baseten provisions the GPUs, syncs checkpoints as your job saves them, and deploys any checkpoint as a production endpoint.
Deploy any synced checkpoint with one CLI command
